pageTitle: You’re eligible to use this service
heading: You’re eligible to use this service
paragraphs: Based on the information you’ve provided, you’re eligible to use this service.
To finish making your claim, you’ll need:
bullets: the address of the property you’re claiming possession of
information about the tenancy or licence
information about your grounds for possession
details about the notice you served
details of the people who are in possession of the property who you are making the claim against (the defendants)
copies of relevant documents, including the tenancy agreement, notice and a rent statement (if your claim is on the grounds of rent arrears)
afterBullets: The defendants will be able to see your answers to the questions and any documents you upload.
Your claim will save as you go, so you can stop and return to it if you need to.
You can review and edit your answers before you submit your claim.
You must sign a statement of truth before you submit your claim. This certifies that you believe that the information you’re providing is true.
